title: Walls, Floors, & Ceilings
summary: Pannenkoek explains how Super Mario 64 handles wall, floor and ceiling collisions, including triangles, normal vectors, quarter steps and out of bounds. It is a detailed 37-minute technical walkthrough of the game's physics.
why: Praised as an engrossing, in-depth look at SM64 mechanics that is surprisingly compelling to watch.

quote.text: each longer than half an hour (and both of them extremely interesting)
